sonnet.problem: The story card says Jehoshaphat 'isn't done cleaning house.' That tells the baker he removes the people left from Asa's days, which is the answer to the true/false question on the next card (card 12).
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: This story card is only a joke about a tray sliding off the counter. It tells no part of the passage and moves the baker forward by nothing, even though it cites verse 48.
sonnet.rule: Every story card tells part of the passage. Jokes ride along on those cards.
